candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Ego continues straight along the original route and rear-ends a slower lead vehicle that starts slightly closer ahead in the same lane, under similar moderate rain and wetness, with nearby pedestrians preserved.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Tighten the longitudinal interaction with a lead vehicle to reliably produce a forward collision while preserving the pattern that ego is moving, perception/prediction and planning are active with unblocked waypoints, but vehicle_cmd remains all zeros despite continued motion. Only small spatial and speed adjustments are applied so the same command–status mismatch and collision timing can re-emerge without changing the root-cause hypothesis.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure at least one non-ego vehicle (e.g., actor_index 2 or 3) ends up in the ego lane ahead of the ego within 0–40 m along the route shortly after spawn.
Verify that perception and prediction object topics are configured to publish and that at least one dynamic object is expected to be in sensor range during the mid-mission segment.
Confirm that planning final_waypoints generation is enabled with no scenario-level configuration that marks the route as blocked.

Check that controller configuration allows a zeroed vehicle_cmd stream (accel, brake, steer, target_speed all zero) even while vehicle_status reports motion (e.g., via external or default throttle behavior), to preserve the command–status mismatch possibility.
post_execution_validation_rules: Confirm oracle collision reports a collision between ego and a non-ego vehicle (preferably actor_index 2) near the end of the run.
Check ego vehicle_status or odometry shows sustained nonzero forward velocity in the several seconds before collision, with brake_cmd remaining effectively zero (no significant braking).
Verify detection and prediction topics contain at least one nearby dynamic actor ahead of ego in the 3–5 s window before collision.
Ensure final_waypoints are present with normal waypoint counts and no blocked flags in the same pre-collision window.
Validate that vehicle_cmd accel_cmd, brake_cmd, steer_cmd, and target_speed remain at or extremely close to zero while ego velocity stays nonzero, matching the command–status mismatch pattern.
Confirm that any closest-object-distance or similar waypoint summary value does not prevent planning from publishing waypoints (no emergency stop/blocked plan triggered).
uncertainty: This variant assumes the root cause is upstream of or parallel to control, but still does not distinguish among perception mislocalization, planning logic, controller behavior, or simulator/vehicle interface issues.

The adjusted longitudinal spacing and speed may alter exact collision timing compared to the seed, but the underlying mismatch between vehicle_cmd and vehicle_status is expected to remain if the same software stack behavior persists.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
